crossRefs.note: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.
let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

translations.web: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise him, O ye servants of Jehovah,
